miniProject.title: Single-process golden trainer founding trainlab
miniProject.brief: Create trainlab and build its single-process core: a tiny transformer with a numerical oracle, a versioned corpus with deterministic sampling, and a frozen golden trainer. Every later section proves distributed equivalence against this core, so resume, lineage and ledgers must be exact here first.
steps: Create `trainlab` with `manifests/`, `data/`, `model/`, `comm/`, `parallel/`, `plan/`, `ckpt/`, `faults/`, `trace/`, `ext/`, `tests/` and `reports/`; add a tiny transformer with a single-process oracle in `model/` and a versioned corpus with a tokenizer in `data/`.

Build a deterministic sampler over the versioned corpus with disjoint-coverage tests, stated padding and drop policies and document-to-batch lineage; interrupt a run mid-epoch and prove the resumed record-ID sequence matches the uninterrupted run.

Implement accumulation over uneven microbatches with size-weighted averaging and one optimizer step per global batch, matching a full-batch oracle; pass the TensorTonic gradient-accumulation cases and show the naive mean-of-means fails as predicted.

Tabulate every training state with owner, dtype and writer; ledger persistent bytes by dtype against measured tensors after the first optimizer update; pass the TensorTonic memory-accountant cases; show a loss-scaling overflow skips and recovers, and checkpointed recompute matches baseline gradients with a smaller peak.

Write a custom autograd `Function` with explicit forward and backward, checked against finite differences; log `register_hook` against `register_post_accumulate_grad_hook` order over accumulated steps and test each against the single-process oracle.

Freeze the golden trainer, interrupt it mid-run and resume in a fresh process from committed state only; prove consumed-ID and optimizer-trajectory equivalence with the uninterrupted run and refuse resume under a changed config with a named reason.

Instrument one step into data, transfer, forward, backward, optimizer and checkpoint phases with synchronization and warmup, reporting spread over repeated trials; capture a labeled profiler trace with a memory snapshot attributed to ledger rows, and locate every `torch.compile` graph break with `torch._dynamo.explain`.
deliverables: The `trainlab` skeleton with `model/`, `data/`, `manifests/`, tests and the frozen golden trainer.
Sampler, accumulation, autograd-hook and resume tests with oracle comparisons and the lineage evidence.
State-ownership table, dtype-aware memory ledger, phase-timing report and the labeled step trace.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Gradient Accumulation Equivalence
checks.note: Pass the public uneven-size cases in your harness before the trainer comparison.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Mixed-Precision Training Memory Accountant
checks.note: Pass the public dtype cases; state the allocator and master-copy exclusions.

rubric.pass: Interrupted and uninterrupted runs yield identical record-ID sequences under both padding policies with disjoint coverage proved.
rubric.strong: A worker-seeding defect is seeded, caught by the tests, and the lineage traces any batch to document IDs.

rubric.pass: Fresh-process resume from committed state matches the uninterrupted trajectory, and changed configs are refused with reasons.
rubric.strong: Each state row dropped in turn fails its targeted check, and CPU resume matches exactly with the settings named.

rubric.pass: Hand ledger reconciles with measured tensors after the first update, and the accountant cases pass with exclusions stated.
rubric.strong: One mispredicted row is explained to allocator or temporary buffers, and recompute keeps gradients while cutting peak.

rubric.pass: Custom `Function` matches finite differences and hook order is logged against the oracle.
rubric.strong: A broken backward is shown to fail the check, and accumulation interaction is tested.

rubric.pass: Phase timers use synchronization and warmup with spread reported, and the trace has no unexplained gap.
rubric.strong: Removing warmup or sync is shown to move the numbers, and breaks are each explained.

miniProject.feedsInto: The golden trainer, sampler, oracle, manifests and ledgers feed every later parallel section and the capstone correctness core.
